host.affinity: First eight listed physical CPU IDs for Base and QuarantineEqualsProposer; all 32 for Retry and RenewRetry. Guest default clock and turbo. One fresh process per cell.

method: Original passing configurations with all published properties and the state constraint; no model edits. One whole-process measurement per mode. Eight-worker controls used the pinned TLC rolling jar and JRE 17 with -Xmx32g -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=8. Core used nominal TLC profile, fp 0, seed 0. Authors used a different TLC version, fingerprint and host. All counts are fingerprint-based.
reproduce: For the eight-worker controls, from tla/spec at the source revision: dive check PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config CFG --workers 8 --fp 0 --seed 0 --compat=tlc --output json. For TLC use -workers 8 -fp 0 -seed 0 -config CFG PaxosLeaseChecked.tla with the specified JVM.

store_reclamation.scope: completed-level measured Store trigger; live frontier, permanent startup and names are retained; not a hard cap or total RSS bound

memory.scope: requested persistent-store component storage before explorer worker teardown; lower bound, not RSS or peak; excludes allocator and Arc metadata, opaque string-index bucket overhead/spare capacity, external shared objects, worker arenas/caches, graph buffers and in-progress growth; rehash scratch fields are allocation traffic and largest individual temporary, not retained or concurrent peak bytes

fingerprint_files_sample.scope: Two .fp files at one instant. Queue, trace and other files excluded.

memory.scope: requested persistent-store component storage before explorer worker teardown; lower bound, not RSS or peak; excludes allocator and Arc metadata, opaque string-index bucket overhead/spare capacity, external shared objects, worker arenas/caches, graph buffers and in-progress growth; rehash scratch fields are allocation traffic and largest individual temporary, not retained or concurrent peak bytes

fingerprint_files_sample.scope: TLC .fp files only. Its queues and trace are additional.

tlc_build: TLC2 2026.10.06.014338 (94d0c50), Eclipse Adoptium JRE 17.0.20.1, MSBDiskFPSet and DiskStateQueue
retry_method: Two independent isolated r7i.16xlarge instances in us-east-1a with default guest frequency policy. Pinned to the same 32 physical cores (one logical CPU/core). Each process had an external 448 GiB cgroup, no swap, and a four-hour check budget. Ordinary Core used --compat=tlc --workers 32 --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 400g --time-limit 14400s on a 160 GiB gp3 root. Pinned TLC used -Xmx192g -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=32 -workers 32 -seed 0 -fp 0 with external timeout 14400s and 1 TiB gp3 (16000 IOPS / 1000 MiB/s) for its disk-backed queues. Actual terminal results and GNU time measurements are distinct from the author’s eight-worker TLC 2.19 numbers.

symbolic_retry_probe.original_reason: Dive frontend: Error: "symbolic checking admits safety invariants and deadlock only"
symbolic_retry_probe.diagnostic_copy_without_cfg_constraint: Dive frontend: Error: "unsupported assumption, initial-role multiplicity or stateful operator"
symbolic_retry_probe.scope: Input-admission observations only. The authors’ constraints and assumptions were preserved in all reported performance runs.

renew_retry_method: Two independent isolated r7i.16xlarge instances in us-east-1a with default guest frequency policy. Pinned to the same 32 physical cores (one logical CPU/core). Each process had an external 448 GiB cgroup, no swap, and a four-hour check budget. Ordinary Core used --compat=tlc --workers 32 --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 400g --time-limit 14400s on a 160 GiB gp3 root. Pinned TLC used -Xmx192g -XX:+UseParallelGC -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=32 -workers 32 -seed 0 -fp 0 with external timeout 14400s and 1 TiB gp3 (16000 IOPS / 1000 MiB/s) for its disk-backed queues. RenewRetry used the same runner on two fresh instances. Actual terminal results and GNU time measurements are distinct from the author’s eight-worker TLC 2.19 numbers.

symbolic_refinement.interpreter: packaged CPython 3.11 with dd.cudd on Linux
symbolic_refinement.command: dive check --strategy symbolic PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config CFG --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --max-memory 24g --time-limit SECONDS --output json
symbolic_refinement.platform: Dedicated r7i.4xlarge, us-east-1a, one physical core via taskset, default clock, 32 GiB cgroup, zero swap. GNU time covers supervisor, domain-learning passes and all binding. Base budget 900 s, quarantine and Retry 1800 s. One observation per cell.

rows.memory_scope: Single live ps RSS sample of the largest process. The supervisor killed the entire process group on timeout. GNU time did not account for that worker’s terminal high-water mark.

symbolic_refinement.interpretation: Cluster the sparse set membership bits with local-state fields indexed by the same participant. Each learning pass starts from the original Init. A constrained-out target remains an invariant obligation. Counts in successful symbolic rows are exact over the represented sets. Explicit reference counts use fingerprint stores.
symbolic_refinement.rejected_probe: Precomposing the complete state constraint with every simultaneous update made the compilation intermediates expensive. The released positive pass instead streams each action image and intersects the target constraint before retaining the next frontier.
symbolic_refinement.initial_ablation: On the shared workstation, the ungrouped generic Base run completed in 185.42 s. For the quarantine case at depth 18 the ungrouped admitted layer had about 3.87 million BDD nodes, compared with about 0.88 million after participant ordering.

prototype.host: EC2 r7i.4xlarge, us-east-1a. One non-sibling physical core 7, 5 GiB per-process virtual memory limit, 900s whole-process deadline. Other experimental single-core searches on separate cores shared the host memory and last-level cache. Single observation per input/arm; GNU time reports wall and maximum child/process RSS.
prototype.source: Original PaxosLeaseChecked.tla and original Base / QuarantineEqualsProposer CFGs pinned above. A private worker transferred only coordinate names, then rebound and checked each complete input. Both warm trials seeded from Base-cold. Cold/warm on a given configuration must agree on counts, depth, and verdict. Cross-configuration hints can introduce dormant coordinates.

installed_candidate.host: Dedicated EC2 c7i.4xlarge, us-east-1a, search pinned to physical CPU 0, no swap. Single ordered invocation per case, small validation checks on other cores. Earlier installed candidate before trace-file and manager lifetime fixes. Per-revision seconds are reported by the checker; native GNU time and peak RSS apply to complete invocations only.
installed_candidate.command: dive check PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config FIRST --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --time-limit 2400s --max-memory 6g --output json; session adds --recheck PaxosLeaseChecked.tla PaxosLeaseBase.cfg --recheck PaxosLeaseChecked.tla PaxosLeaseQuarantineEqualsProposer.cfg

retained_refined_closure_edits.method: Separate fresh installed CLI sessions, sequentially on the same physical core of an isolated c7i.4xlarge. Each session checks the original configuration, repeats it, adds EmissionBound, then adds the false EmptyNetwork obligation. Peak RSS is GNU time's maximum for the session. Row seconds come from the checker. Each false result is independently replayed.

transition_witness_edits.method: Paired sessions on an isolated c7i.4xlarge, both pinned to physical core 0; small independently pinned functional checks shared the host during Base. Same native checker and exporter, compared retained closure from before this change against the candidate worker. Every arm begins cold and edits the original released module through a wrapper. Elapsed seconds per revision from the worker, whole-process time and RSS from GNU time.
transition_witness_edits.recipe: In a copy of PaxosLeaseChecked.tla renamed WithIdle.tla or WithTick.tla, insert EditedNext == Next \/ UNCHANGED vars or EditedNext == Next \/ Tick before the module terminator, and define EditedSpec == Init /\ [][EditedNext]_vars. In the edited CFG replace SPECIFICATION Spec by SPECIFICATION EditedSpec; keep every other setting. Run original, WithIdle, WithTick, original, in that order via --recheck.
transition_witness_edits.command: dive check PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --config ORIGINAL --recheck WithIdle.tla EDITED --recheck WithTick.tla EDITED --recheck PaxosLeaseChecked.tla ORIGINAL --time-limit 3600s --max-memory 7g --output json
transition_witness_edits.validation: Independent cold and explicit comparisons on 27 scalar revisions, eight orbit-counting cases and a seeded 44-revision multigraph with a separate breadth-first enumerator. Covered excluded emissions, shortest validated counterexamples, deadlock, reachable shortcuts, domain growth, multiplicity and changed Init.

symbolic_variable_order_trials.method: Instrumented source-checkout experiments on one isolated r7i.4xlarge, one process pinned per physical core; concurrent runs share memory bandwidth, cache and package power. Trials use the original module and unchanged CFGs. Each logs decision-diagram sizes at layer entry before evaluating invariants or the image. The final logged layer is a progress observation. GNU time RSS in a timeout may omit a killed worker and is not a reliable peak for the entire process tree.
symbolic_variable_order_trials.command: dive check --strategy symbolic PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config CFG --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --time-limit {900s for Base, 7200s for Retry} --max-memory 18g --output json

orders.once: Start static and reorder once at layer 12 when frontier exceeds 2000 nodes

bounded_message_slot_trials.design: Prototype sorted, duplicate-free finite-set entries in fixed slots, coding a learned message by an integer and reserving the highest code for empty. Apply deletions before insertions. Detect overflow even for successors excluded by the state constraint.
bounded_message_slot_trials.method: Same isolated r7i.4xlarge as the order trials, taskset to physical core 6 while independent ordering experiments used other cores. Process-tree RSS from GNU time can omit a worker terminated by the supervisor. Prefix node counts correspond to entry into a layer of the last refinement pass.
bounded_message_slot_trials.reduced_change: PaxosLeaseRetry.cfg with only MaxNetwork = 4 replaced by MaxNetwork = 1.

trials.reason: reachable source emits an assignment outside finite layout
bounded set layout exceeded; see diagnostic

base_capacity_diagnostic.finding: A reachable admitted source with four messages can produce an emission beyond the six-slot representation. The checker refused. The diagnostic replay distinguished overflow from an unrelated invalid encoding.

refined_changed_destinations.model: Source-generated PaxosLeaseChecked wrappers. Reset adds an unconditional simultaneous assignment to the original Init. Drain adds: now = MaxTime AND Cardinality(network) = MaxNetwork, then clear network and leave every other variable unchanged. Replace SPECIFICATION Spec by EditedSpec == Init /\ [][Next \/ EditedAction]_vars; preserve constants, constraints, all invariants and deadlock setting.
refined_changed_destinations.common: One installed source-driven process pinned to CPU 0 per batch, --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains and four --recheck MODULE CFG arguments; 12 GiB / 4800 s cap. Two c7i.4xlarge nodes; timings compare variants only within a node. Each entry records wall seconds reported per revision; process wall and GNU time peak RSS cover the entire batch.

fresh_core.command: dive check Reset.tla (or Drain.tla) --config BaseChanged.cfg --store exact --workers 4 --seed 0 --fp 0 --time-limit 900s --max-memory 9g --output json

refined_changed_destinations.differential_controls: Source fragment, TLC goldens, exact Core and installed-path tests passed. An independently written 22-revision two-root fixture compared 17 successful revisions and five validated violations against fresh explicit Core, including excluded roots/emissions, simultaneous assignments, newly reachable coordinates, changed constraints and shortcuts.

quarantine_equals_proposer.inputs: Same wrappers and proof changes as the Base session. Use PaxosLeaseQuarantineEqualsProposer.cfg and its constants in the original and edited configurations.
quarantine_equals_proposer.host: Same isolated comparison host and CPU 0 as matched_host; --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains, --time-limit 4800s --max-memory 12g, one process per five-revision batch.

additive_layer_edits.method: The installed symbolic checkers differ only in engine.py. Run each three-revision batch in a fresh process, first the old then the new implementation, pinned to CPU 0 of an isolated c7i.4xlarge in us-east-2. Candidate first applies added actions to admitted frontier states, then the full edited relation to admitted states absent from the corresponding old layer. GNU time reports whole-process time and peak RSS. Each observations entry is one run.
additive_layer_edits.command: taskset -c 0 DIVE check PaxosLeaseChecked.tla --config PaxosLeaseSIZE.cfg --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --recheck Drain.tla SIZEChanged.cfg --recheck PaxosLeaseChecked.tla PaxosLeaseSIZE.cfg --time-limit 4800s --max-memory 12g --output json
additive_layer_edits.correctness: Independent review checked 34 edits and 34 fresh controls per mode, ordinary and refined. Explicit breadth-first search checked shortest depth for every vertex of the additive graph. The independent validator accepted all 124 reported witnesses replayed in the review. The committed excluded-source regression requires the real six-state path in both modes.

independent_quarantine_drain.method: Unmodified Drain.tla and QuarantineEqualsProposerChanged.cfg, --compat=tlc --workers 8 --fp 0 --seed 0. Same inputs as symbolic run. Fingerprint and first exact run on one c7i.4xlarge; compact exact store on another x86 EC2 host. Each completed check exhausted the queue.

labeled_crash_grid.module: PaxosLeaseCheckedSym.tla from the publication revision above. Preserve Spec, TypeOK, Safety, StateConstraint and every toggle.
labeled_crash_grid.configs: Start from PaxosLease<model>.cfg, remove SYMMETRY Symm for labeled runs, set Acceptors to the first A listed (a1,a2 or a1,a2,a3) and MaxNetwork to N. Released sizes use A=3, with N=4 for RenewCrash3 and N=7 for ReleaseCrash. The quotient controls retain SYMMETRY Symm.
labeled_crash_grid.host: AWS c7i.4xlarge hosts, Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C, eight physical cores with SMT, 30.8 GiB RAM, no swap. Grid rows are single whole-process GNU time observations. Exact8 used physical cores 0–7. Each symbolic search used one logical CPU. A separate edit experiment used core 4 during some grid runs. The two full-size attempts that reached a resource limit ran on separate hosts. The merged-worker retry was pinned to core 6. An earlier run on core 3 was interrupted by instance retirement before its time budget and supplied no result. These are single observations with different worker allocations.
labeled_crash_grid.source_scope: The guard-only worker predates the merged initial-membership refusal. This model has one Init witness, from deterministic equalities. Historical worker times are reported with their own hashes. The merged worker ran the A2/N1 controls and the full labeled RenewCrash3 attempt.
labeled_crash_grid.reproduce_guard_only: From scripts/symbolic/engine.py at main commit 0b1a4539a844e944b88addffd965eefcc3a9eaa8, replace the region from the def branches signature through the conjunction(0, guard, assigned) call, inclusive, with the same region from main commit f3661df99fa692fa4dde325d13e62085d336ab91. The original continuation and self.ir line of can_count_arms used 30 leading spaces. This reconstructs the exact guard_only SHA-256 above.

commands.exact1: dive check PaxosLeaseCheckedSym.tla --config CFG --store exact --compat=tlc --workers 1 --seed 1 --fp 0 --output json
commands.exact8: dive check PaxosLeaseCheckedSym.tla --config CFG --store exact --compat=tlc --workers 8 --seed 0 --fp 0 --time-limit 900s --max-memory 20g --output json
commands.symbolic: dive check PaxosLeaseCheckedSym.tla --config CFG --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --refine-domains --time-limit LIMIT --max-memory MEMORY --output json

labeled_crash_grid.symbolic_limits: The merged A2/N1 worker used limits of 120 s and 2 GiB. The guard-only A2/N2 and A3/N2 workers used 1,800 s and 20 GiB. The merged full labeled RenewCrash3 worker used 3,600 s and 6 GiB with a 6 GiB cgroup ceiling. The prior full labeled ReleaseCrash worker used 3,600 s and 20 GiB.

RenewCrash3-A3-N4-labeled-prior.reason: unsupported action guard: overlapping boolean alternatives

labeled_crash_grid.originals_on_merged_guard_worker: With the published symmetry directive retained, both original configs refused symmetry on record-valued finite domains (exit 2).
labeled_crash_grid.stopped_memory: GNU time maximum RSS can omit an interrupted descendant. The memory cell is empty for stopped searches. The entire service that ran the prior ReleaseCrash attempt reached 4,848,353,280 bytes across all processes and sequential cases.
labeled_crash_grid.admission: StartAcquire emits one distinct Prepare for each acceptor, including the destination acceptor field. From an empty network at A3/N2, that state violates the network constraint. A2/N2 admits the two-message broadcast, so increasing A at fixed N can greatly reduce this reachable set.
labeled_crash_grid.guard_control: A worker collapsing overlapping state disjunctions returned 13,921 generated for RenewCrash3 A2/N1. TLC, Core and the merged worker reported 19,489 generated, 1,856 distinct, depth 15. StartAcquire includes (p \notin active \/ AllowRenewal).
